THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA  ORAL ORDER

The petitioner is before this Court calling in question the registration of a crime in Crime No.455/2023 for offences punishable under Sections 498A, 506 and 504 and under Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

2. Heard Sri. Hemanth Kumar, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner, Sri. B.N. Jagadeesha,
learned Addl.SPP
appearing
for respondent No.1, Sri. Kapil Dixit, learned counsel appearing for respondent No.2 and have perused the material on record.
During the pendency of these proceedings, it transpires that the parties to the lis have entered into a settlement and have placed on record such settlement along with the joint affidavit.

Terms of settlement reads as follows:
"JOINT AFFIDAVIT We (1) Jagadish Balaram s/o K.M. Balaram, aged about 37 years, residing at No.C-32, Sterling Villa Grande, Seegehalli, Whitefiled,
Bengaluru-560067 and (2) Smt. Sreeparna Nandy w/o Jagadish Balaram d/o Subhash Nandi, aged about 34 years, residing at No.B- 331, DS Max, Sangam Grand,
Seegehalli, Whitefiled, Bengaluru-560067 do hereby solemnly affirm and oath as follows:
We state that the Respondent No.2 is the wife of the Petitioner, the marriage was Sri Jagadishbalaram vs State Of Karnataka on 5 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88106985/
2 solemnized on 02-12-2018.

We affirmed that since the marriage irreconsiderable differences arose between us, the marital life ran into rough weather, resulting in the Respondent No.2 i.e., wife of the Petitioner filing the cases mentioned as under.

1) M.C. No. 617/2023 on the file of the II Addl. Senior Civil Judge, Bengaluru Rural District for desolation of marriage under Special Marriage Act.
2) Crl. Misc. No.1463/2023 on the file of I ACJM court, Bengaluru Rural District.
3) Crime No. 455/2023 registered by the Respondent no.1 on the file of the ACJM Court at Bengaluru Rural District under Sec. 498(A), 504, 506 of IPC r/w Sec. 3, 4,
Dowry Prohibition Act.

We affirm that in view of the settlement arrived between us the Respondent No.2 has agreed to co-operate for the closure of all cases including Crime No. 455/2023 registered by the Respondent no.1 on the file of the ACJM Court at Bengaluru Rural District under Sec. 498(A), 504, 506 of IPC r/w Sec. 3, 4, Dowry Prohibition Act.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
We affirm that the Petitioner has sought for quashing Crime No. 455/2023 registered by the Respondent no.1 on the file of the ACJM Court at Bengaluru Rural District under Sec. 498(A), 504,

We, do hereby declare that what is stated above are true and correct to the best of our knowledge,
belief and information."
4. In the light of application for compounding being filed along with the joint affidavit and offences not being against the State, I deem it appropriate to accept the compounding application and terminate the proceedings against the petitioner in the subject petition.
